texts.closing.subtitle: Year-end closing {0}
texts.closing.preview: THE YEAR HAS NOT ENDED. PREVIEW ONLY: TAX AND RESULT SO FAR. STEPS CAN BE BOOKED FROM 1 JANUARY.
texts.closing.intro: Work through the steps from the top. Each step books what is left of it, dated the last day of the year (series S). If anything earlier in the year changes, the rest shows again until the year is sealed.
texts.closing.checks.title: Pre-flight checks
texts.closing.check.fundValue: Enter the funds' value on 1 January {0} under Investments (standard income)
texts.closing.receivables.title: Unpaid client invoices
texts.closing.receivables.lead: Under the cash method, invoices unpaid at year end are booked as receivables, so the sale and its VAT belong to {0}. The payment clears the receivable.
texts.closing.receivables.accrual: Accrual method in {0}: invoices were booked when issued. Nothing to do.
texts.closing.vat.title: VAT
texts.closing.vat.lead: What is left on the VAT accounts at year end moves to the VAT settlement account (2650): the amount to pay or reclaim in the last VAT return.
texts.closing.taxAccount.title: Tax account
texts.closing.taxAccount.lead: Book what Skatteverket debited the tax account during the year: preliminary tax and VAT, from the tax account history.
texts.closing.taxAccount.preliminary: Preliminary tax (F-skatt) debited during the year (SEK)
texts.closing.taxAccount.vat: VAT debited from the tax account during the year (SEK)
texts.closing.taxAccount.balance: Tax account (1630) in the books on {0}: {1} SEK.
texts.closing.taxAccount.hint: Compare with Skatteverket's balance on the same day. A difference is usually interest: tax-free interest income (8314) or non-deductible interest expense (8423); book it under Ledger core.
texts.closing.reserves.title: Tax allocation reserve
texts.closing.reserves.lead: Part of the profit can go to a tax allocation reserve (periodiseringsfond) and be taxed later, at the latest in the sixth year after. It lowers this year's tax; each year it remains it gives a small standard income.
texts.closing.reserves.mustReverse: Reserves six years old must be reversed this year:
texts.closing.allocation.max: At most {0} SEK can be allocated this year ({1} % of the surplus before the allocation).
texts.closing.allocation.saves: A full allocation defers about {0} SEK of tax.
texts.closing.reserves.hint: The allocation goes in INK2 field 3.22 and the reserve under untaxed reserves. Enter 0 to allocate nothing.
texts.closing.tax.title: Income tax
texts.closing.tax.lead: Corporate tax is worked out from the result before tax, adjusted as in the tax return's adjustment form (INK2S).
texts.closing.tax.taxFree: Tax-free income (interest on the tax account)
texts.closing.tax.reserveIncome: Standard income on tax allocation reserves
texts.closing.tax.reserveUplift: Uplift on reversed reserves from before 2021
texts.closing.tax.capitalLossAddedBack: Loss on funds, saved for later years
texts.closing.tax.taxable: Taxable income (rounded down to whole hundreds of SEK)
texts.closing.tax.deficitOut: The deficit of {0} SEK is deducted next year ({1}).
texts.closing.tax.capitalLossOut: Saved loss on funds: {0} SEK. Deductible only against gains on shares and funds.
texts.closing.tax.hint: The tax is booked as a liability (2512). Preliminary tax paid (2518) is set off against it once Skatteverket has assessed it. Group contributions, dividends received and depreciation of equipment are not handled yet.
texts.closing.carried.lead: The {0} closing is not sealed in Liquid. Enter any deficit and saved fund losses from last year's tax return.
texts.closing.result.title: Result for the year
texts.closing.result.hint: The annual general meeting then decides what happens to it: carried forward or paid as dividend.
texts.closing.lock.title: Seal the year
texts.closing.lock.lead: Once everything is booked the year is sealed. After that nothing dated in it can be booked.
texts.closing.lock.bank: The company account balance on {0}, {1} SEK, matches the bank.
texts.closing.lock.notReady: Every step must be done first.
texts.closing.lock.reopenHint: Only to correct something, and before the annual report is signed.
texts.closing.next: The annual report (K2) and the tax return (INK2) come after the closing. They are not built yet: the income statement and balance sheet are under Reports.
texts.log.title: Change log
texts.log.subtitle: Everything changed outside the vouchers
texts.log.hint: Vouchers are never changed: corrections are new vouchers, listed with the others. This logs the rest: settings and company details, accounts, replaced receipts, closings, imports, accepted terms and an administrator's deletions. The log cannot be edited.
texts.sie.title: SIE
texts.sie.subtitle: Move the books to and from other programs
texts.sie.export.title: Export
texts.sie.export.lead: SIE 4 file with the chart of accounts, opening and closing balances, results and every voucher of the year. Other bookkeeping programs, accountants and Skatteverket read it.
texts.sie.import.title: Import
texts.sie.import.lead: Read an SIE 4 file from another bookkeeping program. Missing accounts are added. Imported vouchers go in series E, with the original series and number in the text.
texts.sie.import.vouchersHint: The whole year from the file: opening balances (unless Liquid already has balances before the year) and every voucher.
texts.sie.import.closingHint: When the company moves to Liquid at a year end: the file's closing balances become the opening balances of the year after.
texts.sie.import.hint: Everything is checked before anything is booked: vouchers must balance and not fall in a locked year, and the same file can't be imported twice.
